PR Summary by Qodo

Safeguard autonomous playbook changes and builder job dispatch 🐞 Bug fix ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation ⚙️ Configuration changes 🕐 40+ Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Hold architect-filed playbook changes for human approval, even in autonomous series.
>• Remind builders about pending owner decisions and safely disable background tasks where supported.
>• Align review guidance, operator documentation, and regression tests with these safeguards.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD Owner["Owner files"] --> Dispatch["Daemon dispatch"] --> Runner["Job runner"] Hook["Installed hook"] --> Config["Role configuration"] --> Runner Kit["Stored kit"] --> Engine["Playbook engine"] --> Human["Human approval"] Dispatch --> Engine ```
High-Level Assessment

>The following are alternative approaches to this PR:
1. Persist pending owner decisions
- ➕ Avoid repeated Git-history queries at builder dispatch. - ➖ Adds state to reconcile after merges, restarts, and externally made commits.
2. Trust kit metadata for playbook presence
- ➕ Avoid reading the stored zip during autonomous approval. - ➖ Metadata could diverge from the bytes being approved, weakening the ownership boundary.
>**Recommendation:** Keep the PR’s Git-derived owner reminder and verified-zip approval check: both derive decisions from the current authoritative artifacts rather than introducing state that can become stale. Review the dispatch-time Git cost and the documented exception for a kit filed while the pipeline is already paused.

>
> >tests/test_no_background.py
test_operations.pyCover owner-prefaced dispatch and remove zip-clock flakiness +210/-7
>Cover owner-prefaced dispatch and remove zip-clock flakiness > >
>• Tests owner reminders on builder jobs, ordering with journal reminders, prompt-cap accounting, and apply-resume exemptions. Changes staged-kit tests to compare against bytes actually written and pins the timestamp race.
>

test_operator_table.pyCheck operator-table coverage against published code strings +487/-0
>Check operator-table coverage against published code strings > >

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
